analysis: paired ON-vs-C3 difference + Wilson CI (McNemar); no post-hoc power
bar: C3 non-inferior iff (M_ON - M_C3) <= 1/6 (prereg margin). Volumes exact by construction (8 vs 3 memories).
design: 30 paired tasks; per task ON then C3 back-to-back (same bank state); task order shuffled (seed 7); fresh single-turn rpc sessions; blind grading (answers shuffled, arm-stripped, then unblinded)
spend: Jev ~$0 expected (fresh turn-1 filter snapshots empty); sessions subscription-metered
